newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil stumbles at last fence, closes down.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil stumbles at last fence, closes down.

text.p: IPE gas oil ended lower on Friday in an unexpected slide in light volume before the close, traders said.
March gas oil closed $1.75 a tonne lower at $178.25, having slipped past initial support of $181.25 before meeting stronger support at the day's low of $178.
"The dip was unexpected and I don't have a lot of confidence in it," said one dealer.
"There was no volume on the decline," said another.
One party was seen as the main seller and the inconclusive drop could easily be reversed on Monday, traders said.

April Brent crude was trading up 15 cents at $20.48 a barrel, closely tracking the fortunes of NYMEX. A long weekend in the United States and industry functions in the U.K. next week was likely to take some of the steam out of the complex.
